title: BulbaSwap V3 (Morph) is an unmodified Uniswap V3 deployment — no unprivileged value path
closed_reasons: Factory runtime bytecode == canonical UniswapV3Factory (24535 bytes; differs from mainnet only in the 20-byte NoDelegateCall self-address immutable; identical after zeroing it)
Pool runtime bytecode == canonical UniswapV3Pool (22142 bytes; 376 raw differing bytes, 57 after zeroing token0/token1/factory/pool immutables = fee/tickSpacing/maxLiquidityPerTick constants only)
Verified pool source is byte-identical to Uniswap v3-core (all 31 flattened files after stripping pragma/import/whitespace)
swap/mint/burn/flash follow canonical accounting; fork roundtrips are net-negative
key_facts: canonical mainnet factory 0x1F98431c8aD98523631AE4a59f267346ea31F984; canonical mainnet pool 0x8ad599c3A0ff1De082011EFDDc58f1908eb6e6D8
caveats: Only the WETH/USDT pool was code-diffed directly; all 212 pools use the factory's embedded creation code, and the factory is proven canonical, so all are covered
Peripheral router / NFT position manager were out of scope (they hold no pool funds)
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from BulbaSwap V3: the factory and pools are byte-for-byte canonical Uniswap V3 (only immutable slots differ), so the AMM has no custom value path.
